item.title: Virginia Tech edges South Carolina 86–83 in overtime at Colonial Life Arena
item.description: South Carolina clawed back from an early deficit to force overtime Tuesday night at Colonial Life Arena, but Virginia Tech made the key plays late to escape with an 86–83 win in a non-conference battle. item.title: Augusta man dies after electric scooter collision with pickup truck
item.description: A 55-year-old Augusta man has died following a crash involving an electric scooter and a pickup truck on Tuesday morning, according to Coroner Mark Bowen. The post Augusta man dies after electric scooter collision with pickup truck appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.description: They will not be dropping packages down your chimney, but unmanned air couriers will be able to deliver to your lawn in time for Christmas, if you live near one of six Walmart Supercenters in the suburbs that ring Atlanta.
